run_findings.github_mcp_effective_capability: GitHub MCP Server read-only/exclude precedence changes effective tools. Lockdown is explicitly not an authorization boundary. Classic PAT scope filtering can hide tools, but fine-grained PAT/GitHub App/server tokens show tools and rely on API permission enforcement; scope-fetch failure degrades to no filtering. Tool visibility alone therefore does not prove authorization across auth modes.
run_findings.kubernetes_mcp_stale_capability: Kubernetes MCP Server applies read_only/destructive/tool allow-deny/target-compatibility filters and supports SIGHUP registry rebuild. stateless=true disables tool/prompt change notifications. Thus a cached tools list can become stale after reload without notification; safe mutation protocols need an appropriate re-enumeration boundary.
